skill.name: agentation
skill.description: Install and configure the Agentation visual feedback toolbar in Next.js App Router or Pages Router projects.
skill.summary: Set up development-only Agentation feedback and optional MCP synchronization for Next.js.
skill.author: benjitaylor

security_audit.summary: Three findings confirm instructions to run fixed package or MCP commands, which introduce ordinary dependency and tool execution risk. The other detections are markdown syntax, file names, a documentation link, or a development-only NODE_ENV check. No prompt injection, credential access, or malicious intent was found.

remediation.issue: Package commands use unpinned package versions.
remediation.suggestion: Require user approval, verify package provenance, and install a reviewed version recorded in the project lockfile.

remediation.issue: MCP setup adds an external server to the coding agent.
remediation.suggestion: Explain the server permissions and local port, then obtain explicit approval before installation or agent configuration.

content.value_statement: Collecting precise visual feedback in a Next.js interface can require manual screenshots and descriptions. This skill installs Agentation and configures development-only annotations.
actual_capabilities: Checks whether the Agentation package is already installed.
Detects existing Agentation imports or components before making changes.
Identifies Next.js App Router and Pages Router project structures.
Adds the Agentation component behind a development-only NODE_ENV condition.
Recommends optional MCP setup for real-time annotation synchronization.
limitations: Supports Next.js App Router and Pages Router integration only.
Requires React 18 in the target project.
Package installation and project edits require filesystem and command access.
Real-time agent synchronization needs separate MCP installation, configuration, and restart.

best_practices: Review package provenance and approve installation commands before execution.
Keep the Agentation component behind the development-only environment check.
Check for existing imports and components before editing the application root.
anti_patterns: Do not render the annotation toolbar unconditionally in production.
Do not install packages or configure MCP servers without explicit approval.
Do not add duplicate Agentation imports or components when setup already exists.

faq.question: Which Next.js project structures are supported?
faq.answer: The skill supports App Router root layouts and Pages Router application files.

faq.question: Does Agentation run in production?
faq.answer: The provided setup renders Agentation only when NODE_ENV equals development.

faq.question: Which React version is required?
faq.answer: The skill documentation states that Agentation requires React 18.

faq.question: Is MCP setup required?
faq.answer: No. The toolbar can be configured separately, while MCP enables real-time synchronization with supported coding agents.

faq.question: Can the skill detect an existing installation?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks project dependencies and searches for Agentation imports or components before setup.

faq.question: What access does setup require?
faq.answer: Core setup needs project file access and package installation approval. MCP setup also changes coding-agent configuration.
